data.title: 神尾观铃 · 沿海公路的电车与汽水
data.description: 沿着海岸延伸的单轨电车轨道旁，蝉鸣如同潮水般汹涌。观铃单手抱紧心爱的恐龙布偶，另一只手紧紧抓着罐装蜜桃汽水。电车呼啸而过时，高马尾在阳光下跃动着耀眼的金光。
data.location: coastal train crossing barrier beside sparkling turquoise sea and telephone poles
data.action: standing by yellow-and-black crossing gate hugging a green dinosaur plushie, high ponytail whipped by the passing train draft, smiling warmly
data.lighting: dazzling white midsummer sunlight reflecting off steel rails and azure ocean
data.mood: legendary nostalgic youth, bittersweet summer purity, iconic 2000s anime majesty
data.promptProse: Standing by coastal train tracks clutching a plush dinosaur, golden-haired Misuzu smiles warmly under the vast blue summer sky.
data.animaCaption: Misuzu Kamio holding her plush dinosaur by the seaside railroad crossing.
